findings.title: Delete-cache mutation does not invalidate connected calendars query
findings.body: After `deleteCacheMutation` succeeds, the component only calls `onSuccess`. It does not invalidate `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` (unlike the disconnect mutation). In `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper`, `onChanged` is optional and may not refetch the query, so the cache status/timestamp can remain visible after the cache rows are deleted. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query or update its cache in `onSettled`.

findings.title: Cache status query includes expired cache entries
findings.body: `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` groups all `CalendarCache` rows for the credentials but does not filter `expiresAt >= now()`, while cache reads (`getCachedAvailability`) only use unexpired rows. The UI can therefore show a cache status and allow deleting cache data that is already expired and not being served. Filter by `expiresAt` if the status is meant to represent active cache.

findings.title: Empty updateMany may not update SelectedCalendar.updatedAt
findings.body: `fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache` calls `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` to bump `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt`. Prisma `updateMany` with an empty data object is not a reliable way to update `@updatedAt` fields; if the timestamp update is needed, pass `{ updatedAt: new Date() }` explicitly. Otherwise this call is dead code and can be removed.

findings.title: updateManyByCredentialId accepts relation-update input not supported by updateMany
findings.body: `updateManyByCredentialId` types `data` as `Prisma.SelectedCalendarUpdateInput`, which includes relation operations such as connect/disconnect. `prisma.selectedCalendar.updateMany` only supports scalar update-many inputs, so the repository signature can accept payloads that will fail at runtime. Use `Prisma.SelectedCalendarUpdateManyMutationInput` or `Prisma.SelectedCalendarUncheckedUpdateManyInput`.

findings.title: Actions container renders empty space when dropdown is hidden
findings.body: `CredentialActionsDropdown` returns `null` when there is no cache action and no disconnect action, but it is wrapped in a fixed-width `<div className="flex w-32 justify-end">`. This leaves an empty 8rem action area in list cards/alerts for delegation credentials or when modifications are disabled. Render the wrapper conditionally or move the width styling into the dropdown component.

findings.title: Cache timestamp ignores user locale and time format
findings.body: The cache status timestamp is formatted with `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...)` regardless of the user's locale or time-format settings. Non-English users will see a US-formatted date/time. Use the user's locale (and time format/time zone preferences where available) instead of hardcoding en-US.

findings.title: deleteCache throws generic Error instead of TRPCError
findings.body: When the credential is missing or access is denied, the handler throws a plain `Error`. tRPC will treat this as an internal error rather than a structured NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN error, making client handling and user-facing messages harder. Use `TRPCError` with an appropriate code.

findings.title: credentialId validation allows non-integer numbers
findings.body: The `deleteCache` input validates `credentialId` only as `z.number()`. Credential IDs are integers; accepting floats can pass validation and then produce unexpected Prisma behavior. Use `z.number().int()`.

findings.title: Existing CalendarCache rows are backfilled with migration timestamp
findings.body: Adding `updatedAt` with `DEFAULT NOW()` sets every existing cache row to the deployment/migration time. The new UI will show legacy cache entries as recently updated even though their contents may be much older. If accurate status matters, backfill from a meaningful timestamp or treat pre-existing rows specially.

findings.title: dev:cron uses npx tsx without declaring tsx dependency
findings.body: The script changed from `ts-node` to `npx tsx`, but `tsx` is not listed as a devDependency. `npx` may prompt to download the package or fail in offline/CI environments. Add `tsx` to devDependencies or keep an already-installed runner.

findings.title: ENV_FILE path is relative to current working directory
findings.body: `ENV_FILE="../.env"` depends on where the script is executed. Running `scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh` from the repository root will target the parent directory of the repo, not the repo root. Resolve the path relative to the script location (e.g. `$(dirname "$0")/../.env`).

findings.title: sed invocation is macOS-only
findings.body: `sed -i '' -E ...` uses BSD/macOS in-place syntax. On GNU/Linux, `sed` interprets the empty string as a backup filename and the command fails. Use a portable approach or detect the platform.
